token_set.description: Introducing Hometown History: Dallas Stars, a compilation of highlights commemorating historical moments celebrated by the Stars during the 2023-24 season.  These collectibles not only honor the rich history of the team but also rewind the clock to capture the players and achievements that solidify the franchise in the hearts of fans, and within the pages of NHL history.

description:
In what would be Mike Modano’s final home game donning a Dallas Stars uniform, the crowd at American Airlines Center honored him with a heartwarming standing ovation during the third period of Dallas' game against the Anaheim Ducks on April 8, 2010. Moments later, Modano thrilled them by scoring the game-tying goal with a tip-in off a point shot with less than two minutes remaining in regulation. After a scoreless overtime, the game went to a shootout. With the fans on their feet, Modano skated in and snapped a shot past Ducks netminder Jonas Hiller resulting in thunderous cheers from fans in the American Airlines Center. The Stars went on to win the game 3-2 in the shootout.

description:
In a 2-2 tie with less than three minutes remaining in the second period of Game 6 of Dallas' first-round matchup with Calgary at American Airlines Center on May 13, 2022, Stars defenseman Miro Heiskanen showcased his offensive flair to score the go-ahead goal and eventual game winner to force Game 7. Receiving a pass just inside the blueline, Heiskanen deked Flames forward Matthew Tkachuk and cut back towards the middle, giving him the time and space needed to fire off a shot that sailed through traffic and past goaltender Jacob Markstrom.
